title: Barbra Streisand - A Happening In Central Park - 8-Track Tape Cartridge Columbia
descriptionText:
The Barbra Streisand "A Happening In Central Park" 8-track tape cartridge, released by Columbia. This vintage music format lets you enjoy Streisand's iconic live album on an 8-track player.
Condition: A screw has been driven through the case front-to-back (see photos), most likely from being mounted for wall display — playback is not guaranteed as a result. The back label is also torn and water-stained across the bottom edge. Selling as-is for parts, repair, or display/decor use. No returns accepted, so please review the photos closely before buying.
